description.text: My videos and articles provide in-depth analysis of games from a psychological and philosophical perspective, focusing on how games tell meaningful stories. I like to try and express how games have moved me, whether it's the awesome terror of Subnautica, the life-affirming message of Hellblade, the self-compassion of Celeste, the comforting nostalgia of A Short Hike, or the hard-hitting portrayal of death in Pathologic 2.
